title: Bareilly International University
imageAlt: Aerial view of Bareilly International University Campus
paragraph1: Bareilly International University (BIU) stands as a beacon of academic excellence, innovation, and holistic human development in Uttar Pradesh, India.
paragraph2: Established under the UP State Act, BIU brings together world-class faculties including Rohilkhand Medical College & Hospital, Institute of Dental Sciences, School of Engineering, Faculty of Pharmacy, and School of Management across a sprawling 100-acre green campus.

aboutPage.subtitle: Welcome to Bareilly International University — where academic rigor meets cutting-edge innovation and compassionate healthcare training.
aboutPage.storyTitle: Building a Legacy of Knowledge, Ethics, and Global Leadership
aboutPage.storyParagraph1: Bareilly International University was founded with a transformative vision: to establish an institution of international standards in Rohilkhand region that delivers holistic education, high-impact clinical research, and industry-aligned skills.
aboutPage.storyParagraph2: Spread across a lush 100-acre campus along Pilibhit Bypass Road, BIU encompasses state-of-the-art super-specialty teaching hospitals, advanced simulation labs, smart lecture halls, central digital libraries, and modern sports facilities.
aboutPage.storyParagraph3: With over 150 undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral degree programs, BIU fosters an inclusive ecosystem where students are empowered to solve real-world healthcare, technological, and economic challenges.

features.title: UGC Approved & NAAC A+
features.desc: Recognized by UGC, Medical Council of India (NMC), Dental Council of India (DCI), Pharmacy Council (PCI), and INC.

features.title: Super-Specialty Teaching Hospital
features.desc: Rohilkhand Medical College & Hospital provides hands-on clinical exposure with 1,000+ bed hospital infrastructure.

features.title: Global Academic Partnerships

features.title: 95% Placement Record
features.desc: Dedicated Corporate Resource Center connecting graduates with leading healthcare networks, IT giants, and MNCs.

aboutPage.pillarsTitle: What Defines the BIU Student Experience

pillars.title: Academic Rigor & Research

pillars.desc: Instilling social responsibility, ethical practice, and community service through rural health clinics and legal aid centers.

aboutPage.facilitiesSubtitle: Every facility at BIU is designed to foster academic productivity, health, and campus well-being.

campusFacilities.title: Teaching Hospital
campusFacilities.desc: 1000+ bed super-specialty hospital providing round-the-clock emergency, ICU, and clinical training.

campusFacilities.title: Smart Lecture Halls
campusFacilities.desc: Air-conditioned audio-visual lecture theatres equipped with interactive smart boards and lecture capture.

campusFacilities.title: Central Digital Library
campusFacilities.desc: 50,000+ books, IEEE/PubMed journal subscriptions, and 24/7 quiet reading suites.

campusFacilities.title: Advanced Simulation Labs
campusFacilities.desc: High-fidelity clinical mannequins, dental phantom head labs, and CAD/CAM engineering workshops.

campusFacilities.title: AC Student Hostels
campusFacilities.desc: Separate secure residential blocks for boys & girls with attached washrooms and dining halls.

campusFacilities.title: High-Speed Wi-Fi
campusFacilities.desc: 1 Gbps fiber internet backbone covering all academic blocks, hostels, and campus grounds.

campusFacilities.title: Sports Complex & Gym
campusFacilities.desc: Olympic-size sports grounds for cricket, football, tennis, basketball, and indoor gym.

campusFacilities.title: Multi-Cuisine Cafeterias
campusFacilities.desc: Hygienic food courts serving nutritious meals, snacks, coffee bars, and fresh juices.
